newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle steady at $71 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle steady at $71 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry.
Sales reported on 900 slaughter steers and 1,300 heifers; 73,700 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 12,900 formulated and 3,600 head previously contracted to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs
Wk to Date - 73,700 Week Ago - 22,900 Year Ago - 81,800
